response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_diff FROM s ORDER BY share_diff DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Only observatories that have at least one telescope in the telescopes table are counted (observatories with zero telescopes are not included in the average), since the request defines observatories by observstation in the telescopes table.
